fx_log_return_ks_caveat: Standard two-sample Kolmogorov-Smirnov test assumes i.i.d. observations. Financial returns display significant serial correlation and serial dependence, volatility clustering, and heavy tails; consequently, the KS statistic is reported descriptively and the unadjusted p-value should not be interpreted as an exact calibrated hypothesis test.
model_assumptions: Predictive factor distribution calibrated strictly on 2020-2023 complete-case trading days.
Holdout data (2024, 247 days) was completely isolated and never used during model estimation.
Predictive factor metrics evaluated across 1,000 simulated paths.
Factor paths generated under identical marginal variances and empirical correlation structure.
limitations_notes: Single-year holdout window (247 trading days in 2024) does not span a complete credit or macroeconomic cycle.
2024 realized FX volatility (6.18%) lies between the 20th percentile (5.92%) and 80th percentile (8.71%) of the calibration window, classified as HIGH_VOLATILITY.
Factor-level predictive coverage demonstrates empirical distribution compatibility over 2024 but does NOT establish permanent forward-looking market predictability.
